case_study_name: High-Altitude Eco Resort (Nuwara Eliya Cold Highland)

input_specification.name: High-Altitude Eco Resort (Nuwara Eliya Cold Highland)

recommendation_response.engineering_verdict: The 4-storey Hotel building in Nuwara eliya (Highland Montane) is designed as a Reinforced Concrete Frame structure evaluated against SLS 614 structural load requirements. Highland montane conditions at Nuwara eliya (Humidity: 60%, Rainfall: 2200mm/yr) require high thermal-mass walling materials and moisture-resistant roofing to manage diurnal temperature variation and high precipitation. Site exposure classified as STANDARD — structural and material specifications satisfy minimum SLS requirements for non-aggressive inland tropical environments.
